extension.description: Paste images and files from your local clipboard into a remote terminal — the remote path lands in the prompt, ready for a CLI agent to read.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Pasteport only reads the clipboard and writes to the configured remote directory; the directory setting is machine-scoped, so an untrusted workspace cannot redirect it.
command.paste.title: Paste into Remote Terminal
command.cancelTransfer.title: Cancel Transfer
command.cleanUpRemoteFiles.title: Clean Up Remote Files
command.diagnose.title: Diagnose
config.remoteDir.description: Absolute POSIX directory on the remote host where pasted files land. Leave empty to use the remote host's own temp directory (its `TMPDIR`, falling back to `/tmp`) with a `pasteport` subdirectory. `~` is not expanded.
config.quoting.description: How remote paths are quoted when inserted into the terminal.
config.quoting.auto: Currently equivalent to none; will adapt once TUI quoting behaviour is verified.
config.quoting.shell: Single-quote paths that contain special characters, for use in a shell.
config.quoting.none: Insert paths verbatim, for TUI agents that do not parse shell syntax.
config.trailingSpace.description: Append a space after the inserted path so you can keep typing.
config.confirmAboveSeconds.description: Ask before transfers estimated to take longer than this many seconds, using the measured transfer rate. Set to `0` to never ask.
config.ttlHours.description: Age at which pasted files are removed from the remote host and the local staging directory. Set to `0` to disable cleanup.
config.bracketedPaste.description: Wrap the inserted path in bracketed paste markers (`ESC[200~` … `ESC[201~`). Off by default; compatibility across TUIs is unverified.
